apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata: {name: vuoro-shared, namespace: vuoro-shared}
spec:
  parentRefs: [{name: internal, namespace: gateway, sectionName: https}]
  hostnames: ["vuoro-shared.${DOMAIN_0}"]
  rules: [{backendRefs: [{name: vuoro-shared, port: 8080}]}]
---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata: {name: vuoro-shared-http-redirect, namespace: vuoro-shared}
spec:
  parentRefs: [{name: internal, namespace: gateway, sectionName: http}]
  hostnames: ["vuoro-shared.${DOMAIN_0}"]
  rules:
    - matches: [{path: {type: PathPrefix, value: /}}]
      filters:
        - type: RequestRedirect
          requestRedirect: {scheme: https, statusCode: 301}
